parameters.query: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.is_verified, (SELECT v.status FROM identity_verifications v WHERE v.user_id = u.id ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_status FROM app_users u WHERE u.phone = $1
INSERT INTO identity_verifications (user_id, id_type, id_last4, name_on_id, id_front_key, id_back_key, selfie_key) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
